opportunities.name: Book/film research note (Gutenberg + IMDb + Notes)
opportunities.description: For a given book title, look it up on Project Gutenberg (author, downloads), search IMDb for the film adaptation (year, rating), and write a 'Unit:' note.
steps: Search the title on Project Gutenberg
Open the top result and read the author and download count
Search the same title on IMDb and open the matching film
Read the film year and rating
Add a note: 'Unit: <title> by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>'

steps: Search the country on Wikipedia and read the capital, population, languages and currency

Add a note: 'Geography: <country>, capital <capital>, pop <pop>, <languages>, <currency>, time now <time>'
